voice.name: en-GB-SoniaNeural
voice.prosody: The pod did not go to Mum. It zoomed all the way across the galaxy and landed somewhere cold and grand. This was Dad's palace. And Luna's dad was the strict King who ruled the whole galaxy. Two enormous guards stomped over and marched Luna inside.

voice.name: en-GB-SoniaNeural
voice.prosody: said Dad, tapping his diamond sceptre.

voice.name: en-GB-ThomasNeural
voice.prosody: "Who is This? My own daughter, at last."

voice.name: en-GB-MaisieNeural
voice.prosody: "It was an accident. I just want to go home."

voice.name: en-GB-ThomasNeural
voice.prosody: "You will stay here. One day you will be Queen of the whole universe — so you must learn to be a proper princess. Pretty dresses. Fancy balls. Perfect manners."

voice.name: en-GB-MaisieNeural
voice.prosody: "But I don't Want to wear dresses,"

voice.name: en-GB-ThomasNeural
voice.prosody: "You will go to my royal school,"

voice.name: en-GB-ThomasNeural
voice.prosody: "And that animal cannot stay. We do not keep pets here. Guards — take the bunny away."

voice.name: en-GB-SoniaNeural
voice.prosody: cried Luna. But the guards carried her wriggling bunny off down the hall.
